newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KLSE says places restrictions on Orlando.
newsitem.headline: KLSE says places restrictions on Orlando.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said on Monday it was placing the stock of Orlando Holdings Bhd under trading restrictions from Tuesday.
In a statement, the exchange said Orlando shares would be "designated securities" until further notice.
The KLSE said the sale of Orlando stock is prohibited unless a seller has the company's shares in his stockbroking account.
Buyers would have to pay for the shares immediately to the stockbroking house upon acquiring them.
The exchange places restrictions on stocks which are deemed to have been the subject of excessive speculation or manipulation, a KLSE official told Reuters.
The stock of the men's apparel maker on Monday surged 25 percent or 5.0 ringgit to 25.00 on volume of 4.38 million. Orlando officials were not immediately available for comment.
